hero.eyebrow: Pros bid in minutes — you pick the price
hero.sub: Post your job. Verified pros race to bid. Pay your pro directly once the job's done.
hero.ctaPrimary: Post a Job — Get Bids in Minutes

items.a: Yes — posting a job is always free. You only pay once you accept a bid, and you pay your pro directly once the job is done — Servigic never collects or holds your payment.

items.q: How does Servigic protect me if I'm not paying upfront?
items.a: Instead of holding your money, Servigic protects you with verified pros (CNIC + selfie, police-checked at higher levels), two-way ratings after every job, a masked in-app chat that only reveals your pro's contact once they're on the way, and a dispute/mediation team if something goes wrong.

items.q: What if the pro finds extra work on-site?
items.a: They submit a Change Order with a photo and price — you approve it before any extra work happens, and the extra amount is simply added to what you pay your pro directly.
Every job carries 7-day workmanship support. Open a dispute and our team reviews photos from both sides and helps mediate a resolution with your pro.

items.q: Why can't I see the pro's phone number right away?
items.a: Contact details stay masked in an in-app chat until your pro marks that they're on the way — this closes the window where off-platform deals get made, protecting both of you. Emergency jobs unlock contact immediately.
For Emergency jobs, most customers see their first bid in under 10 minutes since every matching nearby pro is alerted instantly.

Directly from you — cash, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or bank transfer, however you both agree. Servigic never touches that payment; pros settle their 12% commission separately through their in-app Commission Wallet.
Launching in Karachi, then Lahore and Islamabad/Rawalpindi, followed by GCC and North America.

items.q: Why should I book through Servigic instead of just calling the pro directly?
items.a: Booking through Servigic gets you verified & rated pros, two-way reviews, dispute support if something goes wrong, and price competition from real bids — none of which exist if you go around the platform. Repeat bookings are also just one tap with "Book again."

items.q: What happens if I or my pro cancels a booking?
items.a: Cancelling after a booking is confirmed is tracked — occasional cancellations are fine, but a high cancellation rate can pause your ability to post jobs (or a pro's job alerts) for a while. If a pro asks you to cancel so you can work with them directly, tell us — select that reason and we'll review your pro instead of counting it against you.
